LESSON: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Natural and the Built Environments
Topic 1.2: Main physical features in Eastern Africa

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Main physical features in Eastern Africa. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map
2. describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa
3. draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features
4. value the physical features in the locality

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Main physical features in Eastern Africa helps you succeed in SOCIAL STUDIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

KEY FACTS: MAIN PHYSICAL FEATURES IN EASTERN AFRICA
Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.
Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.
Rights come with responsibilities.

PART 1: Identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map

What this means
In this part you learn to identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Main physical features in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa

What this means
In this part you learn to describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Explain: Give one cause and one effect linked to Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features

What this means
In this part you learn to draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Participate: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 4: Value the physical features in the locality

What this means
In this part you learn to value the physical features in the locality. You will use ideas from in your county, school, and Kenyan community.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: value the physical features in the locality.
2. Locate, explain, then act responsibly using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Locate: Connect “Main physical features in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home).

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can value the physical features in the locality. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Main physical features in Eastern Africa is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Good citizens follow rules, respect others, and care for shared places.

Kenyan examples: lining up, keeping the compound clean, telling the truth, helping a classmate.

Example 1: Connect “Main physical features in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map)

Example 2: Give one cause and one effect linked to Main physical features in Eastern Africa. (skill: describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa)

Example 3: Describe one responsible action a Grade learner can take. (skill: draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features)

Example 4: Connect “Main physical features in Eastern Africa” to a real place or group in Kenya (school, market, county office, home). (skill: value the physical features in the locality)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Main physical features in Eastern Africa to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map.
3. Practise this skill: describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa.
4. Practise this skill: draw a map of Eastern Africa and label the main physical features.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Main physical features in Eastern Africa from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Main physical features in Eastern Africa: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study Main physical features in Eastern Africa?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we conserve physical features found in our locality?
2. Why are physical features important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Main physical features in Eastern Africa means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify the main physical features in Eastern Africa on a map.
5. Be able to: describe the formation of the main physical features of Eastern Africa.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
